title: The Alibi Verification Grid
description:
The murder occurred at 9:00 PM in the Parlor.
Suspect 1 was in the Study at 9:00 PM.
Suspect 2 claims he was in the Parlor at 10:00 PM.
Suspect 3 was verified in the Billiard Room at 9:00 PM.
question: Which suspect lacks a verified alibi for the Parlor at 9:00 PM?
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the suspect number.

Example:
Suspect 2
hints: Suspect 3 = Billiard Room at 9:00 PM (Alibi OK). Suspect 2 only accounts for 10:00 PM!
solution_explanation: Suspect 1 was in the Study at 9:00 PM and Suspect 3 was in the Billiard Room at 9:00 PM. Suspect 2 only accounted for 10:00 PM, leaving him without an alibi at the 9:00 PM murder time.
